title: An eye exam within reach: ACCESS randomized trial

rows.name: Autonomous AI
rows.sourceLocator: Table 3 and footnote; Results, primary outcome
rows.notes: Two Baltimore pediatric diabetes sites; 164 youth randomized. AI screening occurred at enrollment; control completion was assessed within six months. One control was excluded after inadvertent enrollment in another study. Three unreachable controls counted incomplete. Completion is not a vision-improvement outcome. Results-section rounded 95% confidence intervals retained.

uncertainty: Unmasked after randomization; two-site trial. Screening timing differs by arm: immediate AI versus referral within six months. Three unreachable controls counted incomplete; source sensitivity analysis reported unchanged significance. Results confidence intervals rounded; abstract gives 95.5–100 and 14.2–32.4. Source discloses sponsor-linked author conflicts.
